ctx.x: So he kept on givin', turning back and lookin' at Zutty. So finally he says "Hey, man, you ain't swingin' me", that's what he told Zutty. So Zutty says "And you ain't swingin' me either". (laughs) I never did stop laughin', all that's goin' on around this place. I laughed like ever about that, I never did forget that -
